judge.rationale: The candidate implements the wrong protocol message names and types (`list_sessions`, `session_list`, `ListSessionsMessage`, `SessionSummaryFrame`, `SessionListMessage` with `sessions` field) instead of what the issue explicitly specifies (`list_conversations`, `conversation_list`, `ListConversationsMessage`, `ConversationSummary`, `ConversationListMessage` with `conversations` field). It completely omits the `transport.history?: {enabled: boolean}` opt-in flag and the `ErrorCodes.UNSUPPORTED` error code. Furthermore, it directly contradicts a core requirement of the ticket by returning an empty list (`sessions: []`) when a store does not implement `listFor`, whereas the ticket explicitly states this must return an `UNSUPPORTED` error and never an empty list. Validation also fails the acceptance criteria by allowing `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` instead of restricting `limit` to 1-200, and it leaves a `.lore/dod.md` scratch file in the repository while omitting the requested changes to `example/full-config.ts` and `docs/getting-started.md`.
